title: Extraction Agent
subtitle: Identify engines, extract text, validate reinsertion.
directoryDropHint: Drop a game folder here, or click Browse.
directoryDropError: Drop one game folder at a time. If its path is unavailable, click Browse.
outputHint: Leave empty to use the game-name_extract folder inside the game directory
runtimeSaveHint: Save to apply directory and interpreter choices
skillSectionDescription: The Skill provides engine detection, text extraction, and reinsertion tools.
skillDownloadHint: Downloads from GitHub are enabled immediately and saved in the user data directory. The original folder is preserved.
pythonAppDescription: The Agent uses the app's existing Python to run scripts by default.
pythonLocalDescription: The local interpreter and its installed packages are used when the Agent requests local Python.
pythonNone: No local Python detected. Select an interpreter path manually.
requirements: Extraction and translation share the same agent engine. Uses the existing app Python and extraction Skill by default. Local Python is used only when explicitly selected.
setupRuntime: The Python adapter is incomplete. Reinstall the app. For source development, run npm run extraction:prepare -- --local in desktop.
missingSkill: Skill is not installed. Download it or select the complete folder containing SKILL.md.
missingPython: Bundled Python is incomplete or unavailable. Reinstall the app.
startText: Choose a game folder. The Agent uses its Skill and local tools to extract the text.
importHint: Open the existing translation project, or start the new project wizard if no configuration exists
composer: Describe an extraction task, check results, or reinsert translations…
noModel: Add an OpenAI-compatible model profile in Settings first.
autoHint: Commands run immediately; Agent questions still wait for your answer.
autoQuietHint: Commands run immediately; questions use the recommended answer, or the first option if none is recommended.
commandWarning: Commands run as your current OS user. Review the command before allowing it.
allowTurn: Allow this tool for this turn
quickExtract: Identify the engine and extract scripts
quickPatch: Package the files in output as a patch in the patch directory
localOnly: Extraction requires a backend on this computer.
retained: Commands continue in the background. You can return to this session.
newOutput: Existing output folders are reused. Creating a session preserves existing files. Only one extraction agent can run per game directory at a time.
stopBeforeClose: Stop the running agent before closing
confirmDeleteSession: Delete this session and its history? Output files will be kept.
confirmCloseFolder: Close this folder in the sidebar? Session history and output files will be kept. Creating a new session for this game will show them again.
chooseSource: Choose a game directory to start
sendHint: Send (Enter to send / Shift+Enter for a new line)
contextUnknown: Context usage will update after the next model response
